Record Class DefaultChangeEvent<E>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.jdbc.notification.DefaultChangeEvent<E>
Type Parameters:
E - The persistent entity type.
Record Components:
operation - The operation reported by the notification provider.
entityValue - The reloaded entity, or null when no entity state is available.
metadata - Provider-specific event metadata, or null when none is available.
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChangeEvent<E>
@Internal public record DefaultChangeEvent<E>(ChangeOperation operation, @Nullable E entityValue, @Nullable ChangeEventMetadata metadata) extends Record implements ChangeEvent<E>
Default change-event implementation used by providers when entity state is already available or intentionally unavailable.
